question.:question/problem:
Consider the vectors

$$
{a}_{1}=\begin{bmatrix}3 \\ 4 \\ 2\end{bmatrix},\,{a}_{2}=\begin{bmatrix}-2 \\ 3 \\ -3\end{bmatrix},\,b=\begin{bmatrix}-13 \\ 28 \\ -22\end{bmatrix}.
$$

If ${x}_{1}{a}_{1}+{x}_{2}{a}_{2}=b,$ then what is ${x}_{1}+{x}_{2}?$
question.:question/worked-solution:
If ${x}_{1}{a}_{1}+{x}_{2}{a}_{2}=b$, then we have

$$
\begin{aligned}{x}_{1}\begin{bmatrix}3 \\ 4 \\ 2\end{bmatrix}+{x}_{2}\begin{bmatrix}-2 \\ 3 \\ -3\end{bmatrix} &=\begin{bmatrix}-13 \\ 28 \\ -22\end{bmatrix} \\ \begin{bmatrix}3{x}_{1} \\ 4{x}_{1} \\ 2{x}_{1}\end{bmatrix}+\begin{bmatrix}-2{x}_{2} \\ 3{x}_{2} \\ -3{x}_{2}\end{bmatrix} &=\begin{bmatrix}-13 \\ 28 \\ -22\end{bmatrix} \\ \begin{bmatrix}3{x}_{1}-2{x}_{2} \\ 4{x}_{1}+3{x}_{2} \\ 2{x}_{1}-3{x}_{2}\end{bmatrix} &=\begin{bmatrix}-13 \\ 28 \\ -22\end{bmatrix}\end{aligned}
$$

Equating the corresponding components, we get the following system:

$$
\left\{\begin{aligned}3{x}_{1}-2{x}_{2} &=-13 \\ 4{x}_{1}+3{x}_{2} &=28 \\ 2{x}_{1}-3{x}_{2} &=-22\end{aligned}\right.
$$

Adding the second and the third equations we get

$$
\begin{aligned}6{x}_{1} &=6 \\ {x}_{1} &=1\end{aligned}
$$

Substituting ${x}_{1}=1$ into the second equation, we get

$$
\begin{aligned}4{x}_{1}+3{x}_{2} &=28 \\ 4(1)+3{x}_{2} &=28 \\ 3{x}_{2} &=24 \\ {x}_{2} &=8\end{aligned}
$$

Finally, we substitute ${x}_{1}=1$ and ${x}_{2}=8$ into the first equation to get

$$
\begin{aligned}3{x}_{1}-2{x}_{2} &=-13 \\ 3(1)-2(8) &=-13 \\ -13 &=-13\end{aligned}
$$

which gives a true statement.

So the solution of the system is ${x}_{1}=1$ and ${x}_{2}=8$, which means

$$
{a}_{1}+8{a}_{2}=b.
$$

Consequently,

$$
{x}_{1}+{x}_{2}=(1)+(8)=9.
$$

question.:question/problem:
Consider the vectors

$$
{a}_{1}=\begin{bmatrix}3 \\ -3 \\ 1\end{bmatrix},\,{a}_{2}=\begin{bmatrix}-7 \\ 5 \\ -1\end{bmatrix},\,b=\begin{bmatrix}2 \\ -4 \\ 2\end{bmatrix}.
$$

If ${x}_{1}{a}_{1}+{x}_{2}{a}_{2}=b,$ then what is ${x}_{1}+{x}_{2}?$
question.:question/worked-solution:
If ${x}_{1}{a}_{1}+{x}_{2}{a}_{2}=b$, then we have

$$
\begin{aligned}{x}_{1}\begin{bmatrix}3 \\ -3 \\ 1\end{bmatrix}+{x}_{2}\begin{bmatrix}-7 \\ 5 \\ -1\end{bmatrix} &=\begin{bmatrix}2 \\ -4 \\ 2\end{bmatrix} \\ \begin{bmatrix}3{x}_{1} \\ -3{x}_{1} \\ {x}_{1}\end{bmatrix}+\begin{bmatrix}-7{x}_{2} \\ 5{x}_{2} \\ -{x}_{2}\end{bmatrix} &=\begin{bmatrix}2 \\ -4 \\ 2\end{bmatrix} \\ \begin{bmatrix}3{x}_{1}-7{x}_{2} \\ -3{x}_{1}+5{x}_{2} \\ {x}_{1}-{x}_{2}\end{bmatrix} &=\begin{bmatrix}2 \\ -4 \\ 2\end{bmatrix}\end{aligned}
$$

Equating the corresponding components, we get the following system:

$$
\left\{\begin{aligned}3{x}_{1}-7{x}_{2} &=2 \\ -3{x}_{1}+5{x}_{2} &=-4 \\ {x}_{1}-{x}_{2} &=2\end{aligned}\right.
$$

Adding the first and the second equations we get

$$
\begin{aligned}-2{x}_{2} &=-2 \\ {x}_{2} &=1\end{aligned}
$$

Substituting ${x}_{2}=1$ into the second equation, we get

$$
\begin{aligned}-3{x}_{1}+5{x}_{2} &=-4 \\ -3{x}_{1}+5(1) &=-4 \\ -3{x}_{1} &=-9 \\ {x}_{1} &=3\end{aligned}
$$

Finally, we substitute ${x}_{1}=3$ and ${x}_{2}=1$ into the third equation to get

$$
\begin{aligned}{x}_{1}-{x}_{2} &=2 \\ (3)-(1) &=2 \\ 2 &=2\end{aligned}
$$

which gives a true statement.

So the solution of the system is ${x}_{1}=3$ and ${x}_{2}=1$, which means

$$
3{a}_{1}+{a}_{2}=b.
$$

Consequently,

$$
{x}_{1}+{x}_{2}=(3)+(1)=4.
$$

$$
\left\{\begin{aligned}{x}_{1}+2{x}_{2} &=-7 \\ 4{x}_{1}-{x}_{2} &=-15 \\ 4{x}_{1}+{x}_{2} &=-17\end{aligned}\right.

\begin{aligned}4{x}_{1}+{x}_{2} &=-17 \\ 4(-4)+{x}_{2} &=-17 \\ {x}_{2} &=-1 \\ {x}_{2} &=-1\end{aligned}

question.:question/problem:
Consider the vectors

$$
{a}_{1}=\begin{bmatrix}-2 \\ 3 \\ 4\end{bmatrix},\,{a}_{2}=\begin{bmatrix}5 \\ 4 \\ -3\end{bmatrix},\,b=\begin{bmatrix}8 \\ -12 \\ -16\end{bmatrix}.
$$

If ${x}_{1}{a}_{1}+{x}_{2}{a}_{2}=b,$ then what is ${x}_{1}+{x}_{2}?$
question.:question/worked-solution:
If ${x}_{1}{a}_{1}+{x}_{2}{a}_{2}=b$, then we have

$$
\begin{aligned}{x}_{1}\begin{bmatrix}-2 \\ 3 \\ 4\end{bmatrix}+{x}_{2}\begin{bmatrix}5 \\ 4 \\ -3\end{bmatrix} &=\begin{bmatrix}8 \\ -12 \\ -16\end{bmatrix} \\ \begin{bmatrix}-2{x}_{1} \\ 3{x}_{1} \\ 4{x}_{1}\end{bmatrix}+\begin{bmatrix}5{x}_{2} \\ 4{x}_{2} \\ -3{x}_{2}\end{bmatrix} &=\begin{bmatrix}8 \\ -12 \\ -16\end{bmatrix} \\ \begin{bmatrix}-2{x}_{1}+5{x}_{2} \\ 3{x}_{1}+4{x}_{2} \\ 4{x}_{1}-3{x}_{2}\end{bmatrix} &=\begin{bmatrix}8 \\ -12 \\ -16\end{bmatrix}\end{aligned}
$$

Equating the corresponding components, we get the following system:

$$
\left\{\begin{aligned}-2{x}_{1}+5{x}_{2} &=8 \\ 3{x}_{1}+4{x}_{2} &=-12 \\ 4{x}_{1}-3{x}_{2} &=-16\end{aligned}\right.
$$

Multiplying the first equation by $3$, the second equation by $2$, and adding the resulting equations, we obtain

$$
\begin{aligned}23{x}_{2} &=0 \\ {x}_{2} &=0\end{aligned}
$$

Substituting ${x}_{2}=0$ into the second equation, we get

$$
\begin{aligned}3{x}_{1}+4{x}_{2} &=-12 \\ 3{x}_{1}+4(0) &=-12 \\ 3{x}_{1} &=-12 \\ {x}_{1} &=-4\end{aligned}
$$

Finally, we substitute ${x}_{1}=-4$ and ${x}_{2}=0$ into the third equation to get

$$
\begin{aligned}4{x}_{1}-3{x}_{2} &=-16 \\ 4(-4)-3(0) &=-16 \\ -16 &=-16\end{aligned}
$$

which gives a true statement.

So the solution of the system is ${x}_{1}=-4$ and ${x}_{2}=0$, which means

$$
-4{a}_{1}=b.
$$

Consequently,

$$
{x}_{1}+{x}_{2}=(-4)+(0)=-4.
$$
